name: Ruri Paracelsus Theophrastus
original_name: 瑠璃・P・テオフラストゥス
source:
The young, pint-sized proprietress of a long-established alchemy shop.
She laments how technology has pushed alchemy into decline and throws herself into reviving it, spreading the word day after day through outreach.
She is the protagonist's childhood friend, and often fusses over him like a doting big sister.

[From [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/kagami-games-to-release-7-visual-novels-including-sakura-moyu/]NookGaming[/url]]
